section_anchor: What a tunneling junction is reading that a Hall sensor isn't
brief_summary: Two side-by-side labelled boxes contrasting Hall-effect sensing (magnet approach generates a voltage, sensor reads voltage directly) against TMR sensing (magnet approach rotates a layer inside a tunnel junction, sensor reads a resistance change), with a caption flagging the finer-resolution claim as vendor-stated rather than independently verified.
